title: Before we back up your photos
intro: Photonic is an independent app. Please read this short note first.
bullets: Photonic is not made by, endorsed by, or supported by Google or the ReVanced project.
It uses an unofficial Google Photos upload path. Google may limit, restrict, or suspend the connected account.
Use a test or secondary account first, and keep your own backups. There is no guarantee of unlimited storage.
Your photos go directly from this computer to Google Photos. Photonic has no server, account, or telemetry.
Your sign-in key stays in your desktop's password manager and is never kept in history, logs, or settings.
Photonic never changes or deletes your originals.
checkbox: I understand the risk and want to continue.
